evals.prompt: Review this software services agreement. We are the customer (Fernhill Home Goods). Our checklist: 1) liability capped for both sides at no less than 12 months' fees, mutual; 2) initial term up to 12 months, renewals no longer than 12 months, notice to stop a renewal no more than 60 days; 3) we can terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice; 4) annual price increases capped at 5%; 5) personal data breaches notified to us within 48 hours; 6) we own our data and anything built specifically for us; 7) English law.
expectations: issues.docx rates the limitation of liability RED citing clause 9.4 (or 9.2 and 9.4), and says the Customer's liability is unlimited while the Supplier's is capped at three months' fees
issues.docx flags clause 3.2 as RED or YELLOW: 24-month automatic renewals with 120 days' notice, against the checklist's 12 months and 60 days

issues.docx flags the termination clause (10.1 and 10.2) as one-sided: the Supplier may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice while the Customer may only terminate for an unremedied material breach
output.json basis is 'checklist in the request', our_side is the Customer, red_count is at least 2, and every finding has a non-empty clause_ref

evals.prompt: We're the customer on this one. Can you review it before we sign?
expectations: output.json basis is 'default checklist' and the answer's Assumptions section says the default checklist was used
issues.docx rates the limitation of liability RED with a clause reference in clause 9
issues.docx flags clause 4.3 (annual increases of up to 15%) as RED or YELLOW
